items.quote: Bitte gleichen Sie diese Rechnung binnen 30 Kalendertagen nach dem Rechnungsdatum aus; Teilzahlungen sind nach Absprache möglich.
items.computation: Invoice date 2026-11-27. Period starts the day after (§ 187 BGB), so day 1 = 28.11; 30 calendar days end on 2026-12-27. That is a Sunday, so under § 193 BGB it moves to Monday 2026-12-28 (not a holiday in NW). A company letter has no deemed delivery, so the period runs from the invoice date.

warnings: The 30th day (2026-12-27) is a Sunday. The shift to Monday 2026-12-28 follows § 193 BGB. To be safe, make sure the payment is credited by Friday 2026-12-25 or earlier.
